hypothesis: TA and TB share zero-latch high-byte auto-start carry behavior.
competitor: The observed TA extra carry does not apply to TB, or is invisible to this transfer aperture.
test: Pair both timers on both CIAs at latch0,1,3 with 0..7 NOP gaps; compare first/second/settled START readbacks, retaining write/read beam brackets.

outcomes.TB differs from emulator in zero only: Extend carry model if latch1/3 controls agree.
outcomes.both timers match: Do not infer hidden TB underflows; preserve aperture limit.
outcomes.broad mismatch: Reject generalization and isolate transfer timing.

next_question: Does TB zero-latch START readback outlive its first LOAD carry like TA?
